mirrorOrOtherProjectWarning: Picture 1 is the '1:500 add-on' icon, not a plan; picture 2 is a thumbnail of render 3. The URL suffix '_2' is the project name 'Miodowy 2' (all captions), not a mirror marker; plan, elevation and render agree (no mirrored picture). The building is a semi-detached pair: plans and elevation show TWO mirror-image segments (house numbers 2 and 4) - intended symmetry, not a mirrored copy. The published facts are for ONE segment (usable 143.82 = exact sum of one segment's 14 labelled rooms on both floors; built-up 99.82 ~ half of the pair's closed footprint), whereas the printed chains 16.10 x 13.62 cover both segments. The upper plan is captioned 'rzut poddasza' (attic) although it is a full storey under a flat (2 deg) roof.

uncertain: Only the front elevation is drawn, so REAR/LEFT/RIGHT openings are marked not shown. From the ground plan: REAR per segment 2 openings (niche double door to the dining area, living-room terrace door + fixed panel) = 4; LEFT 1 window (bathroom 6.78), RIGHT 1 window (mirror). From the upper plan: REAR per segment 2 (loggia double door of bedroom 18.05, door + window of bedroom 19.41 with a railing line) = 4; the upper side walls show no windows.

All inner vertices are TRACED at ~26.5 px/m (one pixel ~3.8 cm): front block side faces 4.06/12.04, hall/kitchen face 1.47, rear niches x 0.60-3.31 and 12.79-15.50 at depth 12.42, and the outer side-wall ends at 13.43 (they stop ~0.17 m short of the central rear face - a 4-5 px step drawn in both segments); right-segment vertices are mirrored from the left and agree with tracing within 1 px.

The upper plan prints no chains and cannot be registered exactly against the ground plan: it traces ~12.6 m deep along the central part vs ~12.1 m for the ground central part, so the upper floor overhangs either the entrance side or the rear by ~0.5 m (the render suggests the upper front is flush with the kitchen face, which would put the overhang at the rear, but the ground plan draws no outline there).
Front balcony on the bedroom block: upper plan outline ~1.6 m deep vs ~1.47 m ground projection - consistent only within the registration uncertainty.

Ground rear niches recorded as roofed because the ground plan draws the outline of the upper loggia's balustrade beyond them; whether the upper loggias themselves are covered by the roof is not shown.
Upper front balcony doors (in the timber panels) counted as DOOR: the plan shows double leaves opening inward; the elevation shows them as two-pane French windows.
Rear terraces and privacy strips come from plan outlines only; depth ~2.5 m traced.
Grey diagonal shapes around the right segment's door and narrow window in the elevation are cast shadows.
Two entrance doors, one per segment, at ~4.1-5.2 m and ~10.9-12.0 m from the left; 'CENTER' refers to the pair.
